# DTT Lib
> Deterministic date, time, and timezone manipulation library for Rust with zero heap allocations, sub-nanosecond precision, and full ISO 8601/RFC 3339 compliance.

## Core Documentation & Resources
- Homepage: https://dttlib.com/
- Getting Started: https://dttlib.com/getting-started/index.html
- Formats & ISO: https://dttlib.com/formats/index.html
- Features: https://dttlib.com/features/index.html
- API Reference: https://dttlib.com/documentation/index.html
- Examples: https://dttlib.com/examples/index.html
- Benchmarks: https://dttlib.com/benchmarks/index.html
- Architecture: https://dttlib.com/architecture/index.html
- Security: https://dttlib.com/security/index.html
- About Sebastien Rousseau: https://dttlib.com/about/index.html
